title: Observability weekly sync — build plan & visual primer
content:
Purpose: quick weekly sync doc + visual primer for product owners and oncall to understand the upcoming metric rename migration, tracing sampling sweep, and dashboard freeze windows. This is a working artifact for the Nov–Jan rollout and contains action items, ownership, and lightweight visuals in prose (use this as speaker notes for the sync).

Scope: product-facing and infra-facing metrics that appear on tenant dashboards, synthesis widgets, and the canary probe set. We are NOT touching low-level exporter labels or Prometheus scrape configs in this pass — those will be tracked separately (see JIRA-OBS-1498).

High-level calendar (approx):
- Week of 2025-11-10: metric rename dry-run in staging (read-only dashboards)
- Week of 2025-11-17: trace-sampling sweep (50 -> 20 pct) on staging and perf cluster
- 2025-11-24 — 2025-11-28: Thanksgiving window — NO PRODUCTION CHANGES (obvious)
- Week of 2025-12-01: dashboard freeze for public product dashboards (no widget schema changes)
- Week of 2025-12-08: staggered rename rollout to production (tenant groups A,B,C)
- 2026-01-05: post-rollout audit and deprecation of old metric names

Metric rename/migration plan (concise):
- Goal: consolidate similar latency metrics into a single metric with label-driven slice semantics (example: inference_latency_ms -> inference_latency_ms{stage,model_variant}).
- Migration strategy: double-write in writers for 2 weeks, then backfill dashboard queries to prefer new metric names. After SLA checks, remove old metric emission.
- Rollout buckets: tenant-group A (internal), tenant-group B (high-traffic customers), tenant-group C (rest). Start with A -> smoke test -> B -> monitor 48h -> C.
- Key success signals: no increase in SLO-failure-rate, dashboard load time within 10%, no increase in query costs >5% week-over-week.

Metric definitions (short canonical entries we will publish to the metric registry during rollout):
- inference_latency_ms: histogram of token-path latencies in ms. Labels: model, variant, route, tenant_id. Use 99th percentile and p50 for SLOs.
- kv_cache_hit_rate: gauge (0-1) across requests; label: tenant_id, model. Computed in writer aggregation.
- prefix_cache_warmth: gauge with discrete bucket label (cold|warm|hot). Helpful for correlation with tail latency.
- request_tokens: counter of tokens per request. Labels: model, route, tenant_id. Increment-only.

Tracing guidelines (practical primer):
- Span naming: <service>.<operation> — examples: runtime.generate, kv.prefetch, router.route-decision. Keep names lowercase and hyphenated for readability.
- Important span tags: tenant_id, model, variant, request_id, route, cache_hit (true|false), tokens. Avoid PII.
- Sampling policy for rollout: implement sweep (staging -> perf -> prod) using severity-weighted sampling: always sample error traces, sample 100% of canary-probe requests, and use target overall sampling rate per cluster (staging 100%, perf 40%, prod 10% default).
- Trace size caps: max span count per trace = 120, max bytes per span = 8k. If trace gets truncated, emit trace_truncation_count metric.

Dashboard notes & visual primer (what to show during sync):
- Top row (single pane summary): 1) SLO success rate (30d), 2) p99 inference latency (model-level), 3) active model pool utilization. These should be the only permitted public tiles on product dashboards.
- Second row (operator-facing): 1) kv_cache_hit_rate heatmap by tenant, 2) prefix_cache_warmth distribution, 3) trace-sampled error waterfall.
- Widget sizing heuristic: keep expensive time-series (long retention aggregations) to smaller widgets and link to drilldown dashboards for heavy queries.
- Query cost guardrails: any panel that uses >5M rows in a 24h query must be gated and moved to pre-aggregated table.

Investigative checklist (for oncall or sync):
- If p99 latency jumps >20%: check prefix_cache_warmth and kv_cache_hit_rate, then look for recent model rollouts in rollout logs.
- If dashboard load errors spike: check query budget panel, check whether any new metric name is being queried (old->new mismatch).
- If traces are missing for an operator flow: verify sampling policy and the trace-header propagation across sidecars (router -> runtime -> kv).

Owners & contact matrix (short):
- Migration lead: Ava Thompson (eng-observability) — overall rollout coordination.
- Tracing lead: Rohit Mehta (eng-infra) — sampling scripts and retention tiers.
- Dashboard steward: Lina Gomez (product-hosted-api) — panel approvals and freeze enforcement.
- Canaries & ops: Marcus Li (site-reliability) — canary probes, SLI checks, escalation.

Open questions / risks (we will surface in weekly sync):
- Query cost bump risk when double-writing + dashboards querying both names. Mitigation: short-term pre-aggregation and enforced read-only dashboards during dry-run.
- Tenant tagging completeness: some legacy tenant_ids are missing. Need small backfill (JIRA-OBS-1423).
- Trace volume drift: reducing sampling will reduce tracing signal for rare failure modes — plan is to keep 100% sampling for canary probe requests and to instrument a fallback microtrace collector for error traces.

Action items (next 7 days):
- [Ava] finalize double-write patch and create PR -> linked PR once ready (aim: 2025-11-09).
- [Rohit] publish sampling sweep script and perf cluster checklist (deadline: 2025-11-12).
- [Lina] lock freeze window and notify product owners; generate pre- and post-freeze dashboards (deadline: 2025-11-07).
- [Marcus] schedule canary runs and create smoke test rubric (deadline: 2025-11-09).

Speaker notes and sync flow (5–10m):
1) One-slide summary of goal + calendar.
2) Short demo of staging dashboards (read-only) pointing to double-write metrics.
3) Quick explanation of trace sampling sweep and why we lower from 50 -> 20 pct in staging/perf.
4) Ask: Product owners approve freeze window? Ops approve canary rubric?

Appendix (links & snippets):
- Quick query snippet for new histogram p99: avg(rate(inference_latency_ms_bucket[5m])) by (le,model) — convert to percentile in UI via histogram aggregation.
- Trace span example: {"name":"runtime.generate","tags": {"model":"gptx-7b","route":"chat-completion","tenant_id":"tenant-123"}}

Notes-to-self (rough):
- Keep this doc short; maintain a single canonical checklist in JIRA.
- After rollout, replace this doc with the finalized migration postmortem and metric-registry entries.

Unresolved / backlog: retention-tier decisions for traces >30d (defer to Rohit roadmap).

End of doc.
